title: All About Peace
lyrics:
the truth of life is
its not about money
its not about what you got
its not about your car
its not about your house
its not about your job
its not about what you drink
its not about what you smoke
its not about getting drunk
its not about getting hi
its not about your clothes
its not about your shoes
its not even about you
we go thru this life valuing the things that we think we need.
we go thru life holding on to things that cant hold us but only hold us back we go thru life valuing things that dont value us we walk a path of selfishness never looking to help no one or even thinking of doing what's right
we stair at our phones looking at pictures
of the beauty thats right out side. we let others dictate the way we feel and how we act for what and why. because we feel like we need to be accepted by everyone. if we could just let it all go and go back to how comfortable it felt to be a child and stop worrying about the things that dont matter and nothing you possess on this planet is going with you but your memories and i pray your memories have nothing to do with physical things only feelings. only then
we would know that its all about
peace
its all about faith
its all about hope
its all about love
its all about god
that its all about
peace
its all about faith
its all about hope
its all about love
its all about god
that its all about
peace
its all about faith
its all about hope
its all about love
its all about god
